subject.title: [Bug]: auth-profiles test suite has cross-file mock/env leakage; directory run nondeterministically red

question: Should a maintainer sponsor a focused auth-profiles test-isolation fix for the protected suite flake now?
rationale: The report and source evidence are strong enough to keep open, but the protected label and lack of executed current-main directory proof make this a human-owned promotion decision.

options.title: Sponsor focused isolation fix
options.body: Reproduce the directory run on the approved test backend, then refactor the shared OAuth/auth mock setup and cleanup until the whole directory is stable.

options.title: Require current-main proof first
options.body: Ask for or run a fresh Testbox/Crabbox directory-run transcript before approving implementation work.

options.title: Defer as maintainer flake debt
options.body: Leave the issue open but unqueued until this suite flake recurs in required CI or blocks another auth fix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused isolation fix
recommendation.body: Reproduce the directory run on the approved test backend, then refactor the shared OAuth/auth mock setup and cleanup until the whole directory is stable.

likelyOwner.reason: They reported the flake immediately after carrying the adjacent auth-profile fix and already documented the directory-run failures in the merged PR body.
